stock.description: KOALA Financial Group Limited operates as an investment holding company, offering a broad spectrum of financial services across Hong Kong. Its primary activities encompass securities brokerage, underwriting, share placements, and money lending. Additionally, the company manages securities investments, provides margin financing, leases investment properties, and delivers asset management services. The firm was formerly known as Sunrise (China) Technology Group Limited before rebranding to KOALA Financial Group Limited in June 2017. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
